entities.summary: Persian poet and Sufi mystic (1207-1273) whose Masnavi and Divan-e Shams-e Tabrizi are masterworks of world poetry. Born in Balkh (modern Afghanistan), Rumi settled in Konya where his ecstatic poetry on divine love, spiritual longing, and human unity transcended cultural boundaries, making him the best-selling poet in the United States 800 years after his death.
